The integration of KGs and LLMs has gained significant attention in recent research due to the complementary strengths of these two technologies. KGs provide structured representations of knowledge, capturing entities and their relationships, while LLMs excel at generating human-like text based on patterns learned from vast amounts of data.

By combining KGs with LLMs, researchers aim to enhance the factual accuracy and contextual relevance of generated text. KGs are particularly valuable for tasks requiring explainability because they provide causal reasoning, factual knowledge, and interpretable semantic relationships.
